BTS Group Continues the Spirit of Giving Through Its Second Blood Donation Drive of 2026

Back 13 May 2026

On 13 May 2026, executives and employees from companies within BTS Group, led by Mr. Sumit Srisantithum, Chief Operating Officer; Mr. Nattachai Pradermchit, Director of Safety and Security, Bangkok Mass Transit System Public Company Limited (BTSC); Mr. Tawatchai Panichayakorn, Operations Director of the Pink and Yellow Lines, Northern Bangkok Monorail Company Limited (NBM); and Dr. Nalinrut Masomboon, Associate Director of the Sustainability Department, BTS Group Holdings Public Company Limited ("BTS Group"), joined together in the Group’s second blood donation drive of 2026 in support of the Thai Red Cross Society under the theme "MAY OF GIVING: Giving from the Heart... for a New Life."

The campaign successfully collected a total of 127,350 cc of blood, which will help save lives and alleviate blood shortages faced by the Thai Red Cross Society. This achievement reflects the collective commitment of BTS Group’s executives and employees, who recognise the importance of contributing to society through selfless giving. Through this initiative, BTS Group continues to support access to life-saving medical treatment and foster a sustainable culture of generosity for the benefit of Thai society.

For more information, please contact Facebook Page: BTS SkyTrain or Line official: btsskytrain, and Passengers can also check the real-time service status via the “THE SKYTRAINs” application.
